historyCopy: History covers analysed companies from today’s selected indexes, with coverage varying by quarter. Held companies outside those indexes are not included. Today’s index membership and restated accounts create survivorship and hindsight bias.

The fair-price count includes every buy-qualified company in that quarter and market scope. Headline gains are equal-weight average price changes for those picks and for all analysed index companies with available returns, including failed quality tests. Companies without a measured price change are excluded from averages. The headline follows the market switch, not the other list filters. Returns exclude dividends and are not annualised; overlapping cohorts are not an investable portfolio.
Calendar-quarter close; annual quality uses reports filed strictly before quarter end, with a 90-day fallback when filing dates are unknown or equal period end.

Valuation uses the existing annual normalization capped by filed trailing owner earnings: four consecutive quarters, two consecutive halves, otherwise the last annual report. Expected return is the IRR of the same valuation.
Stored judgement is restricted to annual periods and evidence filed before quarter end. Current report readings and current share-count overrides are excluded.
Cached financials may be restated. Current issuer classification, bond yields, FX and surviving universe are retained; this is not a vintage point-in-time backtest.
Monthly close series are not interpolated; cached split bases may differ. Realized price gains exclude dividends.

Hit rates are the share of finite cohort returns strictly above the unrounded median return of all analysed companies for that fiscal year; ties are not hits. Empty return cohorts have null statistics.
